description.en: Sets the engine's current "game sub phase" (a finer-grained state within the overall game phase), used to coordinate internal systems with what stage of an event/scene is currently running.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Advance the engine's game sub-phase
CMND_SET_GAME_SUB_PHASE(_subPhase);
